stories.headline: Iran war Day 5: US sinks Iranian warship off Sri Lanka, death toll tops 1,000, Strait of Hormuz paralyzed
key_facts: US submarine torpedoed Iranian Navy frigate IRIS Dena in the Indian Ocean approximately 40 nautical miles south of Galle, Sri Lanka, killing approximately 80 crew members
Iran's death toll from five days of US-Israeli strikes surpassed 1,045; four additional US soldiers killed in Iranian retaliatory strike in Kuwait bringing US total to six dead
At least 200 ships including oil and LNG tankers remain stranded at anchor off Iraq, Saudi Arabia and Qatar as Strait of Hormuz blockade enters fifth day
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth declared the US is 'accelerating, not decelerating' strikes, with operations expanding 'deeper into Iranian territory'
NATO air and missile defense systems over Turkey destroyed an Iranian ballistic missile fired over the eastern Mediterranean; intended target unclear
Israel carried out dozens of waves of strikes hitting Natanz nuclear facility, Mehrabad Airport in Tehran, Shiraz Air Force base, and Basij headquarters across Iran
Iran continued retaliatory drone and missile attacks across Gulf states targeting energy infrastructure in Kuwait, Iraq, Saudi Arabia and UAE
New York Times reported Iranian intelligence operatives signaled openness to CIA for talks on ending the war, briefly calming oil markets

stories.headline: Trump threatens to cut off all trade with Spain after Madrid refuses base access for Iran strikes
key_facts: Trump directed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to 'cut off all trade with Spain' after Spain denied US use of jointly operated military bases for Iran strikes
Spanish Foreign Minister José Manuel Albares said Spain would not allow bases to be used for strikes not covered by the UN Charter
Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez responded: 'The position of the government of Spain can be summed up in four words: no to war'
Trump also claimed Spain was the only NATO country refusing his call to raise defense spending to 5% of GDP
UK initially refused base access then reversed course allowing use for 'defensive' operations; Trump said he was 'very disappointed' approval 'took far too long'
France and Germany jointly warned they would take 'defensive action' if Iran escalated but stopped short of endorsing the strikes

sources.title: 'No to war': Spain PM hits back at Trump threat to cut trade over air base dispute

key_facts: At least 200 ships including oil and LNG tankers remain anchored off Iraq, Saudi Arabia and Qatar as Strait of Hormuz blockade enters fifth day
Brent crude traded at $81.67/barrel after hitting $84.48 intraday, near highest since January 2025; WTI at $74.56/barrel
Trump pledged US Development Finance Corporation will provide political risk insurance for maritime trade through the Gulf at 'very reasonable price'
Trump said US Navy will begin escorting tankers through the Strait of Hormuz 'as soon as possible'
Italy's government is likely to send SAMP/T air defence system to Gulf states after Iranian strikes prompted military aid requests
Wall Street strategists warned oil could surge above $100/barrel if Strait closure is prolonged; about 20% of global crude consumption transits the waterway
Prices pared gains after NYT reported Iranian operatives sought talks with CIA to end conflict

stories.headline: Ukraine-Russia peace talks in limbo as Kremlin says Abu Dhabi venue 'impossible', Europe proposed
key_facts: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said 'It's pretty much impossible to talk about a potential meeting in Abu Dhabi at the moment' due to Middle East war
Peskov acknowledged 'Americans obviously have had a lot more on their plates in recent days' but said he saw no indication Iran conflict would change US approach to Ukraine
Zelenskyy told Corriere della Sera that talks could proceed March 5-6 as planned and named Switzerland, Turkey, Austria and the Vatican as alternative European venues
Key US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had been simultaneously managing both Ukraine and Iran diplomacy, with Iran track collapsing
Core deadlock remains: Russia demands Ukraine cede entire Donbas; US proposed territorial exchange which Zelenskyy rejected
Kremlin sources told Bloomberg Russia may abandon US-brokered talks if Ukraine refuses additional territorial concessions

stories.headline: Russia blames Ukrainian drones for first-ever attack on Russian LNG carrier in Mediterranean
key_facts: Russia's transport ministry accused Ukrainian naval drones of attacking the Russian LNG carrier Arctic Metagaz, which caught fire in the Mediterranean
If confirmed, it would be the first time Ukraine has attacked a Russian LNG carrier
All 30 crew members were reported safe after the vessel caught fire
Russia called the incident an 'act of terrorism'
The vessel was en route to Port Said in Egypt, according to Libya-based reporting
Attack represents significant escalation in Ukraine's targeting of Russian energy export infrastructure

sources.title: Russia blames Ukrainian drones for attack on LNG ship in Mediterranean

stories.headline: Russia accuses US of using 'imaginary threat' from Iran as pretext for regime change
key_facts: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said US used negotiations with Iran, which were taking place as recently as last week, as cover for a plan for regime change
Russia accused US of attacking Iran on 'false pretext' and called Washington's calls for Iranians to seize power 'cynical and inhumane'
Russia has strategic partnership with Iran and has been relying on Iranian military support including Shahed drones for its war in Ukraine
Statement marks Moscow's clearest condemnation yet of the US-Israeli military campaign against Iran

stories.headline: Block cuts 4,000 jobs — 40% of workforce — as Jack Dorsey bets on AI replacing workers
key_facts: Block announced layoffs of more than 4,000 of its 10,000+ employees, reducing workforce by nearly half
CEO Jack Dorsey wrote in shareholder letter: 'Intelligence tools have changed what it means to build and run a company'
Dorsey added 'a significantly smaller team, using the tools we're building, can do more and do it better'
Block shares soared more than 25% in after-hours trading and rose almost 17% on the Friday following the announcement
Bloomberg reported suspicions of 'AI-washing' with cynics saying companies exploit AI fear to justify old-fashioned cost-cutting
Dorsey said the move was 'not a response to financial strain' with gross profit and customer growth remaining strong
Block is parent company of Square, Cash App and Afterpay

stories.headline: Chinese phase 1 trial of in vivo base editing gene therapy for familial hypercholesterolemia published in Nature Medicine
key_facts: Phase 1 trial results of YOLT-101, an adenine base editing therapy targeting PCSK9 gene for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH), published in Nature Medicine on March 3
Trial conducted at Ren Ji Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, developed by YolTech Therapeutics
Demonstrates proof-of-concept of liver-targeted PCSK9 base editing for familial hypercholesterolemia in humans
Nature Medicine editorial called it a 'base editing milestone for familial hypercholesterolemia'
Follows Verve Therapeutics' VERVE-102 data showing 53% mean LDL-C reduction and up to 69% maximum reduction at 0.6 mg/kg dose in Heart-2 trial
Represents growing global competition in one-time gene editing treatments for cardiovascular disease

stories.headline: FDA lifts clinical hold on Intellia's CRISPR gene therapy trial for heart amyloidosis
key_facts: FDA removed clinical hold on Intellia Therapeutics' MAGNITUDE Phase 3 trial of nexiguran ziclumeran (nex-z) for ATTR-CM on March 2
Hold was placed October 29, 2025 after Grade 4 liver transaminases and elevated bilirubin observed in a patient dosed with nex-z
Separate MAGNITUDE-2 trial for hereditary ATTR with polyneuropathy had hold lifted in January 2026
New safety measures include enhanced liver monitoring, short-term steroid guidance, and exclusion of patients with ejection fraction below 25%
Nex-z is based on Nobel Prize-winning CRISPR/Cas9 technology and aims to be first one-time treatment for ATTR amyloidosis
Intellia is engaging with clinical trial investigators, ethics committees and international regulatory authorities to resume enrollment

sources.title: Intellia Therapeutics Announces FDA Lift of Clinical Hold on MAGNITUDE Phase 3 Clinical Trial in ATTR-CM
